# g.tec medical engineering

> g.tec (Austria, since 1999) makes EEG/ECoG amplifiers, wireless EEG, ultra-high-density electrode grids, stimulators, BCI software and complete clinical BCI systems for brain mapping, stroke rehabilitation and disorders of consciousness. This file indexes a public knowledge base with specifications and peer-reviewed results, each linked to its source.

Product pages on www.gtec.at are the authority for current specifications and regulatory status. Unicorn products are not medical devices.

## Products
- [g.HIamp](products/g-hiamp.md): high-density EEG/ECoG/sEEG amplifier, 16–256 channels per device, up to 1,024 synchronized, 24-bit, up to 38.4 kHz, FDA-cleared and CE-certified
- [g.USBamp](products/g-usbamp.md): 16-channel 24-bit biosignal amplifier, up to 38.4 kHz, < 0.4 µV noise, trigger I/O, for BCI and closed-loop research
- [g.Pangolin](products/g-pangolin.md): ultra-high-density EEG/EMG/ECG grids, 8.6 mm spacing, up to 1,024 channels with g.HIamp
- [g.Nautilus](products/g-nautilus.md): wireless EEG, 8–64 channels, PRO Flexible (clinical, FDA/CE), Research, Multi-Purpose, with fNIRS (NIRx) or eye tracking (Tobii)
- [Unicorn](products/unicorn.md): 8-channel 24-bit wearable EEG (BCI Core-8, Hybrid Black) and 4-channel headband for BCI development, education, art and animal EEG; Unicorn tDCS Core-2 wearable brain stimulation
- [cortiQ 2.0](products/cortiq.md): real-time high-gamma functional brain mapping, electrical stimulation, CCEP and SEP for epilepsy and tumor surgery
- [recoveriX PRO](products/recoverix.md): motor imagery BCI with FES and avatar feedback for stroke and MS rehabilitation, CE-marked
- [mindBEAGLE PRO](products/mindbeagle.md): EEG assessment of command following and YES/NO communication for UWS, MCS and locked-in patients
- [Software](products/software.md): g.Pype (Python), g.HIsys (MATLAB/Simulink), g.BSanalyze, g.Recorder, OSCAR artifact correction

## Prices and showcases
- [Unicorn prices](prices/unicorn-prices.md): BCI Core-4 Headband from €390, Hybrid Black from €1,189, Core-8 from €1,100 (excl. VAT); raw data access included, no subscription
- [VR/XR for €390](showcases/vr-xr-for-390-euro/README.md): Unicorn BCI Core-4 + Unity plugin streams EEG band power into Meta Quest
- [EEG during a backflip](showcases/backflip/README.md): raw Unicorn Hybrid Black data recorded through a backflip

## Code and documentation
- [g.Pype on GitHub](https://github.com/gtec-medical-engineering/gpype): Python SDK for real-time BCI and neuroscience pipelines
- [g.Pype manual for LLMs](https://gpype.gtec.at/llms.txt)
- [Unicorn open EEG datasets](https://github.com/unicorn-bi/Unicorn-BCI-Core-8-EEG-Datasets): raw and preprocessed EEG (CSV, BDF) for resting state, AEP, P300 oddball, VEP and MRCP paradigms recorded with the Unicorn BCI Core-8
- [Unicorn on GitHub](https://github.com/unicorn-bi): device manuals, APIs, LSL/UDP streaming, Unity plugin, sample datasets
